Wind and Limits

27 Sep, 2026

I worked overtime today, and went for a run in the evening. According to Zepp's plan, today's run was 11km. The last time I ran more than 10km was back in August.

Out the door, walk a stretch, stretch both arms out, twist the waist, loosen the ankles — getting ready for a long run. Music mixed with the voices of passersby around my ears; a lot of people come to the park for a walk, and I don't like crowds. I started running. While running, my head was very clear, and I was surprised at how clear-headed I was.
